headline: TWSE: Margin maintenance ratio is managed per account; misunderstanding of information may affect judgment | Securities
summary: The Taiwan Stock Exchange reaffirmed that the credit trading collateral maintenance ratio is managed at the whole-account level. It urged investors to understand the system and assess risks carefully amid sharp recent swings.
why: Margin trading lets investors borrow to buy shares, and the exchange sets rules on collateral requirements that affect forced selling risk.
